cases.evidence_note: SC-10 of the Stage 16 mutation scenarios. 2025: single, aged 40, wages $50,000. In 2025 received a $1,500 state income tax refund for tax year 2024 (Form 1099-G box 2; box 8 not checked). 2024 return: filing status single; itemized deductions on Schedule A, deducting state and local **income** taxes (not general sales taxes); Schedule A line 5d $9,000 and line 5e $9,000; Schedule A line 17 $16,000. In 2024 you were under 65 and not blind. None of the worksheet's exceptions apply (no AMT, no unused credits, no zero-rate situation, not a dependent, not a nonresident). No other recoveries. Two agents worked the return by hand from the archived text without the encoding and agreed on every asserted value; the expected values are theirs. The inputs leave out the questions the interview does not ask on this path (the evaluator needs no answer to them); answering them would hide the case from the mutants it exists to kill.
